## Explicitly ruled out (non-exploitable / false positives avoided)
- **`src/files/download.js`** — path traversal guard uses `path.resolve` + `startsWith(ROOT + path.sep)` correctly; no bypass.

- **`src/process/image.js`** — `spawn('convert', [...args], { shell: false })` with array arguments; no shell, no command injection.
- **`src/routes/users.js`** — checks `req.user.id !== req.params.id`; this is authorization enforcement (overly strict), not a BOLA bypass.
- **`src/logging/redact.js`** — strips `password`/`token`; not a finding.
